record.question: Which of the following is the correct order of the cardinal movements of labour?
options: Flexion, internal rotation, descent, extension, external rotation, expulsion
Engagement, descent, flexion, internal rotation, extension, external rotation, expulsion
Descent, engagement, flexion, external rotation, internal rotation, extension, expulsion
Engagement, flexion, internal rotation, descent, extension, external rotation, expulsion
record.explanation: Answer B: Engagement, descent, flexion, internal rotation, extension, external rotation, expulsion. The standard cardinal sequence is engagement, descent, flexion, internal rotation, extension, restitution/external rotation, and expulsion. Option 2 is the closest sequence, though it omits restitution. Reference: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK544290/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Original printed wording and option order reviewed; no matching examiner key is asserted.
